title: Prayer After Confession
text:
My dearest Lord Jesus,
I thank You with all my heart
for the mercy You have shown me
in the Sacrament of Reconciliation.
You have washed away my sins
and restored me to Your grace.

Help me to keep the resolution I have made
to avoid sin and grow in holiness.
Strengthen me against temptation,
and grant me the grace to live
as Your true disciple.

May the peace I have received
bear fruit in good works,
and may my life be a witness
to Your infinite mercy.

Amen.
notes: This prayer of thanksgiving is recited after receiving absolution in the Sacrament of Reconciliation, expressing gratitude for God's mercy and resolving to amend one's life.
description: A prayer of thanksgiving after receiving absolution in the Sacrament of Reconciliation
